observation: The first post-surface repository artifact parser attempted to use System.Text.Json.JsonDocument, which is unavailable in the installed Windows PowerShell runtime. It therefore reported a type-resolution error for every nonempty JSON document and JSONL record.
mutation: none; the wrapper only read files
correction: Repeat the complete JSON and JSONL audit with ConvertFrom-Json, while separately retaining the repository's one known historical zero-byte JSON evidence item and counting UTF-8 BOM documents.
release_effect: The invalid parser run is excluded from positive evidence. A corrected full parse must pass before the package/source gate can close.
